{{Short description|none}} {{refimprove|date=May 2025}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2025}} {{Infobox football match | title = 1933 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Final | image =1933 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final programme.jpg | image_size = 250 | event = [[1933 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]] | team1 = [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] | team1association = [[File:Kilkenny colours.PNG|40px]] | team1score = 1–7 | team2 = [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] | team2association = [[File:Limerick colours.PNG|40px]] | team2score = 0–6 | details = | date = 3 September 1933 | stadium = [[Croke Park]] | city = Dublin | man_of_the_match1a = | referee = Stephen Jordan ([[Galway GAA|Galway]]) | attendance = 45,176 | weather = | previous = [[1932 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|1932]] | next = [[1934 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|1934]] }} The '''1933 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final''' was the 46th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the [[1933 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], an inter-county [[hurling]] tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at [[Croke Park]], Dublin, on 3 September 1933, between [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] and [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]]. The Munster champions lost to their Leinster opponents on a score line of 1–7 to 0–6.{{cite book |last=Bellew |first=Ronnie |last2=Crowe |first2=Dermot |date=2014 |title=Hell for Leather: A Journey Through Hurling in 100 Games |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Hell_for_Leather/wjfuBQAAQBAJ |publisher=[[Hachette Books]] |isbn=9781444789928 |access-date=May 20, 2025}} {{TOC left}} {{Clear}} ==Match details== {{football box |date=1933-09-03
